newsitem.title: USA: Lenfest says it, News Corp settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Lenfest says it, News Corp settle suits.

text.p: Lenfest Communications Inc and News Corp Ltd have settled lawsuits filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and the Supreme Court of New South Wales, Australia, Lenfest said Monday.
The lawsuits were settled by agreeing to dismiss all claims without payment of any damages, Lenfest said in a statement.
It was not clear from the company's statement if Lenfest and News Corp were the plaintiffs or the defendants. The exact nature of the lawsuits also was not disclosed.
Lenfest said later Monday that the companies had filed lawsuits against each other in a dispute over an alleged oral agreement related to the recapitalization of an Australian pay television company.
News Corp had contended that Lenfest had agreed not to negotiate with the pay television company, Australis Media Ltd, without first consulting News Corp. Lenfest is a part owner of Australis Media.
News Corp filed its suit against Lenfest in Australia, while Lenfest filed its action against News Corp in federal court in Pennsylvania.
